description: Run timeline commands and check the rendered frame.

identity.goal: Complete the trim sequence use case of filmcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the filmcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `filmcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced filmcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `filmcraft_command_list`, `filmcraft_command_run`, `filmcraft_render_frame`. Steps: (1) Look up the timeline commands. (2) Run the trim commands. (3) Render the frame to verify. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace filmcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
